Sandbox_MowingWithScythe_XPMultiplierMow:
Allows you to adjust the XP gained from mowing the lawn action.
Set to 0 to disable XP gain.
Sandbox_MowingWithScythe_GrassTuftsMulti: Allows you to adjust the number of grass tufts gained from mowing the lawn action.
Sandbox_MowingWithScythe_GrassSeedsMulti: Allows you to adjust the number of grass seeds gained from mowing the lawn action.
Sandbox_MowingWithScythe_XPMultiplierRak:
Allows you to adjust the XP gained from raking leaves action.
Set to 0 to disable XP gain.
Sandbox_MowingWithScythe_LeavesMultiplie: Raking Leaves - Dead Leaves Gain Multiplier
Allows you to adjust the number of dead leaves gained from raking leaves action.
Sandbox_MowingWithScythe_XPMultiplierSow:
Allows you to adjust the XP gained from sowing grass seeds action.
Set to 0 to disable XP gain.
